mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PROJECT_EXPERIENCE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY START_DATE DESC NULLS LAST ,CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TECH_STACK T USING ( SELECT #{techName} TECH_NAME FROM DUAL ) S ON (LOWER(T.TECH_NAME) = LOWER(S.TECH_NAME)) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TECH_ID ,TECH_NAME ,CATEGORY ,CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( TECH_STACK_SEQ.NEXTVAL ,S.TECH_NAME ,'ETC' ,SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT TECH_ID FROM TECH_STACK WHERE LOWER(TECH_NAME) = LOWER(#{techName})
SELECT T.TECH_NAME FROM PROJECT_TECH P JOIN TECH_STACK T ON T.TECH_ID = P.TECH_ID WHERE P.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ORDER BY T.TECH_NAME
SELECT FEATURE_ID featureId ,PROJECT_ID projectId ,FEATURE_NAME featureName ,DETAIL detail ,SORT_ORDER sortOrder FROM PROJECT_FEATURE WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER

SELECT TROUBLE_ID troubleId ,PROJECT_ID projectId ,TITLE title ,PROBLEM problem ,CAUSE cause ,SOLUTION solution ,RESULT result ,CREATED_AT createdAt FROM PROJECT_TROUBLE WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ORDER BY TROUBLE_ID
